title: Effect of noncompliance.
bodyText: Failure to comply with any requirement imposed by this chapter shall not render any agreement void or voidable nor shall it constitute a defense to any action to enforce such agreement or any action for breach of such agreement.
bodyHtml: [§487A-2]  Effect of noncompliance.  Failure to comply with any requirement imposed by this chapter shall not render any agreement void or voidable nor shall it constitute a defense to any action to enforce such agreement or any action for breach of such agreement. [L 1980, c 36, pt of §1]
